I5.quote: This manuscript describes cost-effective synthesis of heteroatom self-doped activated biocarbons from sword bean shells (ACBS) by a simple two-step process of carbonization and activation using different weight ratios of KOH/chars.

notes: Primary research article (Electrochimica Acta). H2 uptake measured from the gas phase at 77 K on KOH-activated sword-bean-shell carbons, 0-1 bar (ASAP 2020) and 0-40 bar (HPVA-100), shown in Fig. 7(a,b). The supercapacitor work is capacitance in 6 M KOH, not hydrogen electrochemistry, so it does not affect I1. All four samples are majority carbon by mass (EA, Table 1). BET areas are given per sample in Table 2. The paper does not say it is retracted and does not say its uptake values were published before.
